data.name: Roxanne The Forgotten Path
data.detailed_description:
Special Offer

Free DLC!

We want to thank the community that supports our game. We'll be releasing free DLC with exclusive additional content: new abilities, enemies, secret areas, and special challenges.

Thank you for being part of this adventure!


Special Offer

New free content!

We'll unlock free DLC that will expand the Roxanne: The Forgotten Path experience. This content will include:

New abilities for Max, expanding exploration and combat possibilities.

New side quests that will reveal hidden secrets of the underground world.

New NPCs with new stories, rewards, and challenges.

Be part of this evolution.


NOTE

Greetings, it's a pleasure to accompany you on this adventure, so any compatibility report is welcome. We'll be releasing updates every week, but don't worry. Currently, these updates are improvements or extensions to the game to make this adventure unforgettable. Thank you for your support, and stay tuned to see how we evolve.


About the Game

Roxanne: The Forgotten Path is a 2D adventure and platformer game with a metroidvania essence, immersing players in a vibrant, mysterious, and challenging underground world. You play as Max, an ethereal soul who awakens in dark caves with no memories, holding onto only one name in mind: Roxanne.

As you explore various biomes, you'll face enemies, unlock special abilities, and solve challenges while uncovering fragments of your past. Max can transform into water to slip through cracks, harness the Essence of Aether to attack and activate portals, along with other abilities that enhance mobility and combat.

Visually, the game blends dark environments with magical lighting, particle effects, and a semi-realistic aesthetic that amplifies the sense of mystery and magic. The narrative unfolds progressively through echoes of the past, encounters with NPCs, and exploration of a world filled with secrets.

Meet Roxanne: The Forgotten Path — a 2D metroidvania indie adventure wrapped in vibrant tones and professional, multi-palette art that shifts with each level.

  • ⚙️ Upgraded physics: traps fire energy objects that remain dangerous even on the ground, plus simulated knockback/ricochets when you’re hit for extra weight and realism.

  • 🧠 Adaptive enemies that react to and learn from your movement.

  • 🌀 Unique abilities that evolve with weekly patches.

  • 🌍 Biomes & unique runs: same stages, but every playthrough feels different—anything can happen.

  • 🎯 Player-driven difficulty: your decisions shape the challenge; collectibles and chests amplify your build/progression.

  • 💻 Available on PC now, with plans for more platforms.

  • ✅ Please check compatibility on our Steam page; the game will keep evolving.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 / Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 / Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or higher
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
